You: H-hello?
…
It seems nobody is here and it’s really dark...
Shouldn’t Priestbot be here at least?
Hmm…{{wi}} Maybe Shanice put him inside the sacristy?
Here’s not there either.
This is kinda weird. Shanice would tell me if she was about to take Priestbot somewhere for sure.
I need to look around this place one more time.
Huh? {{wi}}Weird...
Between the benches I can see little red beads…{{wi}} Wait a minute, aren’t these…
???: You! What are you doing here! This is private property!
Wha?! {{wi}}Who is this guy?!
